## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what is broken.

## To reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install with `npm install`
2. Start with `npm run dev`
3. Open `http://localhost:3000`
4. ... (click, type, upload a VRM, etc.)
5. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include console output if relevant.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124, Edge 124, Firefox 125, Safari 17]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 16.14.2]
- `npm` version: [e.g. 9.6.7]
- Commit / branch: [e.g. `main` @ `b542aa0`]
- OpenAI model used: [e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`]

## Screenshots / recordings

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the
problem.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — e.g. VRM model used, system prompt, custom
voice settings.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and there is no duplicate
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` locally
- [ ] I have included the relevant console output
